invariant: Detection alone grants no join, gameplay, Pause, silent-reacquisition, or takeover authority; one-player takeover requires deliberate Resume from a currently visible candidate after recovery opens.

scenarios.title: Passive spectator detection grants no authority

checks.detail: A visible spectator remains an unassigned candidate.
The spectator has no gameplay slot.
A spectator-only pause completion cannot open the overlay.

scenarios.title: Household interference cannot act for a joined player

checks.detail: Pet, mirror, and television detections do not replace Player 1.
No household interference track receives gameplay authority.
Interference-only action completions cannot open Pause.
The exact joined player can still open Pause while interference is visible.

scenarios.title: A passerby cannot silently recover or control a lost session

checks.detail: A different visible track cannot satisfy silent reacquisition.
Recovery requires an explicit Resume after the same-track window.
A passerby has no gameplay authority while recovery is open.
Explicit Resume restores the selected original track without takeover.

scenarios.title: Only explicit Resume transfers a one-player session

checks.detail: A replacement player remains a candidate until Resume.
Explicit Resume transfers the one-player slot to the selected replacement.
Spectator and passerby tracks cannot substitute for retained Player 2.
A deliberate non-empty roster reduction resumes without outsider takeover.

report.qualificationBoundary: Synthetic state-machine evidence only; no person, animal, mirror, television, room, camera, tracker, or target-hardware qualification has run.

claimBoundary: Deterministic camera-free state-machine evidence only. It proves the authored authority transitions for synthetic opaque tracks; it does not measure false detection, identity stability, action accuracy, latency, comfort, safety, or behavior of a camera, tracker, person, animal, mirror, television, passerby, room, game runtime, or target appliance.
limitations: Interference roles are assigned by the fixture oracle; the runtime does not semantically identify people, animals, reflections, or displays.
Synthetic track continuity does not model detector false positives, identity swaps, overlap, occlusion, tracker restart, or camera error.
The single deliberate takeover proves a state transition, not comprehension, consent, controller assignment, profile/save ownership, or competitive fairness.
The separate 70-cell and 840-trial physical campaign remains unexecuted.
